title: German-Style Roasted Broad Beans
description: A simple side dish that brings out the natural sweetness in broad beans. This German-inspired recipe uses fresh broad beans and a hint of garlic.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the broad beans with olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the broad beans on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Roast in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Remove from oven and toss with butter until melted.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
